🚨 Traffic Advisory 🚨

In view of #IPL2026 match (#SRHvsRR) at Uppal Stadium on 13-04-2026, traffic congestion is expected from 12:00 hrs to 24:00 hrs at Uppal Junction and surrounding routes (Nagole–Habsiguda & Boduppal–Amberpet). Heavy vehicle diversions are in place; commuters are advised to use alternative routes via LB Nagar, Nacharam, NFC & ORR.

🅿️ Parking: Penguin, TGIALA, DSL Open Area & Modern Bakery
🚗 VIP Parking: Inside Stadium (Gate 1A only)
Avoid Uppal during peak hours & prefer Metro/RTC.

#MalkajgiriTraffic #MalkajgiriPolice #Uppal #TrafficUpdate #StaySafe
